text: The EU has opened a formal antitrust investigation into Meta's policy limiting how AI providers can use WhatsApp's Business API. Meta's October policy restricts AI providers from delivering services to customers via WhatsApp when the AI is the primary product. EU concern: the policy may block third-party AI competitors from accessing a dominant communication platform (WhatsApp). Fines can reach 10% of global annual revenue. Trump has threatened counter-investigations and tariffs against the EU's actions targeting US tech firms.
